From the same creators of Fetch. Re-enter the enchanted world of Drawn in the highly anticipated third installment of the cinematic series. Set in the years before the events of The Painted Tower and Dark Flight, Drawn: Trail of Shadows takes players on a magical Adventure through the distant past! Become a part of the story by following clues scattered throughout paintings to save a boy with the power to create painted worlds in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/567240/]Drawn: Trail of Shadows![/url]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Fetch
notes.content:
Fetch™ is Now Available on Steam!

How far would you go to save your best friend?

The core of Fetch is the sensational and fantastic journey of a boy attempting to rescue for his best friend: his dog, Bear. It is a romp through the marvel of childhood, equal parts adventure and arcade. Fetch replaces the traditional brain-bending puzzles of the adventure game genre with high quality arcade experiences.
